==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am in a virtual city. I have the power to fly, but I enjoy skating everywhere I go. When I fly while riding my skateboard, I look as if I am riding a hoverboard through the sky.

The city is plagued by storms and villains. In order to help protect it, I have a superhero alter ego. My superhero suit includes an oversized helmet resembling a corgi, a green vest, a yellow cape, black pants, and white boots.

Being a vigilante is illegal. Despite using my powers to help people, I am hounded by the police. I don't mind it though, as I enjoy the thrill of the chase.
